result.title: Beyond Time Induction: Structured Conditional Neural Solvers for Parametric Stochastic-Volatility Pricing
result.summary: Physics-informed neural networks provide a flexible framework for learning parametric PDE solution families without labeled data, yet preserving accurate derivatives across heterogeneous regimes remains challenging. Structured neural solvers offer compact representations, but restrictive conditional parameterizations can limit adaptation across the solution family. We introduce BeTINN, a structured conditional architecture extending time-induced modulation through multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway. We evaluate BeTINN on the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, a demanding parametric problem with mixed derivatives and economically relevant first- and second-order sensitivities. BeTINN improves joint accuracy across normalized option value and key sensitivity metrics relative to our baselines. Controlled ablations characterize the roles of its architectural components. We further find that validation physics loss is informative but does not fully determine differential fidelity, and that accurate solution values can coexist with localized derivative errors. These results support structured conditional adaptation and motivate derivative-aware evaluation when sensitivities are downstream quantities of interest.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 BeTINN，一种结构化条件神经求解器，通过对时间与参数的多方向条件调制及联合残差通路，在无标签条件下学习 Heston 随机波动率 PDE 的解族，并评估期权价值与一、二阶敏感性的联合精度，辅以组件消融。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多方向条件调制＋残差通路」可能为 latent 状态的输入条件化更新提供架构借鉴；而「验证物理损失不能完全决定导数保真度、整体值准确可伴随局部导数误差」这一发现，可类比 latent 推理评价中总体指标掩盖局部失败的问题，可供核查。
